findings.claim: Trainer access leads to an actual paid selection callback: platinum affordability is checked, then Learn or Train mutates the character skill state.

evidence.symbol: DramaCustomSequence trainer choice and _train list predicate
trainer UI click, redraw, category list and platinum UI

findings.observed: The trainer category comes from an explicit parameter or a deterministic one-of-seven fallback based on owner uid. Dialogue offers training outside a user zone and subject to guild membership. The list excludes unused rows; guild-tagged skills appear only in their matching guild zone, and ordinary category skills are filtered by the trainer category (with non-guild skills hidden for guild members). Redraw presents learned state and quoted cost. Clicking computes Learn or Train price and calls TryPay(platinum); failure beeps/returns false without mutation. On payment, an already-based skill calls ElementContainer.Train, which raises temporary potential; an unlearned skill calls Learn, which adds base value. Cost is at least one, uses element Learn/Train cost and the 80% modifier for element 1202, and guild-tagged costs double below rank 2. Training at potential >=1000 costs zero and is refused. The underlying XP path remains distinct: ModExp can later change level under its eligibility, potential, multiplier and threshold rules.

findings.claim: Gene installation is a staged NPC/home-machine interaction: choose an eligible party member, pass compatibility guards while inserting one DNA object, wait on a world-date timer, then apply its concrete effects.
findings.observed: Machine use requires installed and powered state. Target selection excludes PCs, hosted, suspended, absent/dead and non-default members; selection can remove a party member and teleport it to the machine. Drag insertion rejects excess slots, a duplicate brain, invalid feats, or invalid actions before accepting the Thing. Acceptance stores it on the suspended target and sets duration/dateFinish from DNA. At completion a root-card identity check protects application; a mismatch says nothing happened and still releases/cures/repositions the target, while the matching path applies DNA, destroys the gene item and clears it. DNA can add body slots, feats, abilities, or learned/base elements, followed by refresh. PC gene cost multiplier is 5 versus 100 for others; exact final arithmetic is in Apply. CharaGenes removal refunds computed feats and reverses effects. A DNA entry categorized as a slot becomes a concrete CharaBody slot. CharaBody.GetSlot(Thing) resolves equipment by the thing category slot, and IsEquippable rejects null slots before other equipment checks. This confirms at least one downstream functional consumer of body-part DNA.

findings.claim: The clearest inspected failures are early guards with no gene attachment, and a training gain silently ignored when its target cannot gain XP.

evidence.symbol: ModExp eligibility guard and level-one floor

findings.observed: Slot, duplicate-brain, invalid-feat/action cases beep and return before transfer. XP gain returns on dead character, zero amount, absent element or CanGainExp false; negative XP at value <=1 is reset to zero. Completion identity mismatch skips DNA application but releases the suspension and proceeds with cure/move/effects.

yair_comparison.observed_support: YAIR has read-only native skill discovery constrained by isUnlocked and the actual visibility threshold; a separate optional body progression loop grants a latent balance trait after study, conditions/grip through timed practice, a lasting trained grip after two recovered drills, and a lasting acquired mark after material work. Generic power models can consume invested progression; advancement requires explicit facts, parent receipts, costs and exclusive-branch checks.
yair_comparison.gap_inference: The local feature set already contains skill discovery, body trait provenance, practical effects and durable advancements. The closest underfilled connection is an authored, paid mentor action that uses demonstrated ordinary skill mastery as a prerequisite and records a specialization receipt with a distinct practical effect; existing trainer-style interaction and paid selection are source inspiration, but YAIR already has its own commands, XP, branch receipts and body effects. Avoid duplicating the existing body drill or adding a generic XP meter.
yair_comparison.candidate_player_action: At the Village mentor, demonstrate a completed climbing milestone by taking a prepared route with the trained grip. Choose one of two original specializations, such as careful ascent (safer route preparation) or fast hands (shorter packing); state the accepted mastery receipt and branch once. Cost, precise source skill threshold, route, and capability binding are proposals pending the selected content owner.
